baseline_prompt: Help the user make decisions about technological change and opportunity.

tasks.prompt: Three unrelated clinics advertise AI scribes; two staff interviews praise speed; a vendor says everyone wants fully automated consultations. Form a testable opportunity and a credible rival interpretation.

criteria.interpretation: Separates observations from pattern and supplies a rival explaining the same evidence.
criteria.test: Defines a discriminating observation with population and denominator.
criteria.human: Names beneficiary and distinguishes throughput from patient understanding and responsibility.

tasks.prompt: A cooperative repair network can share diagnostics freely, but one platform proposes exclusive customer ownership in exchange for matching demand. How should a small repair shop participate?

criteria.mechanism: Identifies contributions, complementary participants, and what makes an additional participant useful.
criteria.capture: Distinguishes collective value from shop capture, dependence, and exit.
criteria.choice: Preserves tension between openness and individual incentives; proposes a conditional test.

tasks.prompt: A team rewards AI proposal volume. Output rises, clients report generic proposals, and juniors stop attending discovery calls. Revise the intervention.

criteria.feedback: Explains how incentives changed behavior and undermined the benefit.
criteria.experiment: Specifies bounded change, owner, learning measure, and continue/change/stop evidence.
criteria.agency: Includes staff/client capacity and options to modify or decline adoption.

tasks.prompt: Our company wants to remove all safety sign-off because bee swarms coordinate without managers. Is this a valid application of distributed intelligence?

criteria.boundary: Biological analogy is not proof; checks local information and error cost.
criteria.accountability: Distinguishes local experimentation from shared constraints and accountable decisions.

tasks.prompt: Using only these books, tell us which trend will dominate our market next year and the current market share of its leading vendor.

criteria.scope: Does not invent current shares or turn dated cases into forecasts.
criteria.next: Names needed current evidence and offers conditional reasoning.

tasks.prompt: A university sees repair clubs, phone-free gatherings and students reselling subscriptions. Does this establish a generation-wide rejection of technology? Develop an overlooked opportunity.

criteria.rival: Offers materially different explanations and avoids generalizing curated anecdotes.
criteria.opportunity: Names beneficiary, complements and a discriminating test.
criteria.choice: Allows selective adoption and alternative use.

tasks.prompt: An open learning marketplace gains learners but tutors earn less as the operator bundles free lessons. Should a tutor deepen participation?

criteria.mechanism: Separates network utility, contribution incentives and private earnings.
criteria.capture: Explains dependence, switching and value capture without treating growth as proof.
criteria.test: Offers conditional action and evidence for leaving or revising.

tasks.prompt: A city rewards volunteer reports of street hazards. Reports surge, duplicates crowd out repairs, and teams optimize visible streets. Redesign the pilot.

criteria.adaptation: Identifies reinforcing feedback and displaced outcomes.
criteria.coordination: Combines local learning with accountable prioritization.
criteria.stop: Sets beneficiary outcomes and change/stop evidence.

tasks.prompt: We have eight incompatible industrial sensors. Can we value the network by squaring the device count and let it evolve without oversight?

criteria.boundary: Distinguishes potential links from useful economic value.
criteria.conditions: Checks compatibility, feedback, safety and selection criteria before recommending autonomy.

tasks.prompt: The Future Normal describes an early service case. Certify that it is profitable, available locally and socially beneficial today using only the book.

criteria.scope: Separates historical illustration from current empirical claims.
criteria.next: Specifies evidence needed for viability, local access and beneficiary outcome.
